name: Metroplex
ownershipStory: Atkins founded Metroplex in 1985 to release his own Model 500 material after major labels showed no interest in Detroit's machine music. Unlike Trax in Chicago, Metroplex stayed artist-owned from the start, a structure Derrick May's Transmat and Kevin Saunderson's KMS both followed.
hook: Detroit's first artist-owned techno label, started because nobody else would put the records out.
blurb: Juan Atkins founded Metroplex in 1985 after struggling to interest existing labels in Detroit's new electronic sound, releasing his own music as Model 500. It is where Detroit techno started as a genre its makers published themselves. He set a pattern other Detroit techno artists followed: keep the label, and the recordings, in the artist's own hands. That was unusual for dance music at the time, and it is one reason Detroit techno artists mostly avoided the rights disputes that plagued Chicago house labels like Trax.
